query: Does hydroxychloroquine reduce mortality in hospitalised COVID-19?

pubmed.title: RECOVERY: hydroxychloroquine did not reduce mortality
pubmed.summary: In hospitalised COVID-19 patients, hydroxychloroquine did not reduce 28-day mortality compared with usual care.

openalex.title: Early observational report suggesting hydroxychloroquine benefit
openalex.summary: An early single-centre observational report suggested hydroxychloroquine reduced mortality in hospitalised COVID-19; later randomised evidence contradicted this.

cochrane.title: Cochrane living review: no mortality benefit for hydroxychloroquine
cochrane.summary: Living systematic review found hydroxychloroquine does not reduce mortality in hospitalised COVID-19 and may increase adverse events.
